tier: Free plan (Android and iPhone by the minute)

free_tier.stated: Free plan at USD 0 a month: 1 concurrent phone, 60 phone credits (60 Android or 20 iPhone minutes) a month, 500 AI credits (USD 5), 1 GB residential traffic, 1 GB storage and no overage charges.
free_tier.notes: An Android minute uses 1 phone credit and an iPhone minute uses 3. Free has no overage; 100 phone credits can be topped up for USD 3 at any time. Paid plans start at USD 20 a month.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the metered unit is phone time, not an object

retention.stated: A stopped Android phone keeps its apps and data; free-plan storage is 1 GB.

egress.terms: residential traffic is pooled across the phones per month: 1 GB included on Free, then a USD 3 top-up of 100 phone credits does not add traffic; paid plans charge USD 10 per GB
egress.free_allowance: 1 GB residential traffic a month on Free

interface_detail: A Cloud REST API at api.mobilerun.ai/v1, TypeScript and Python SDKs, a hosted MCP server, and a web console; a cloud device is created, driven by a task, then stopped.
tooling: @mobilerun/sdk (npm), mobilerun-sdk (pip), MCP server, cURL against the REST API, and Puppeteer or Playwright over CDP on a cloud Android phone.
chaining: An agent provisions a hosted Android phone by the minute, drives it with an SDK or MCP, and reads SMS and email from add-on numbers and mailboxes; a dedicated always-on Android phone costs USD 50 a month, or USD 64 a month billed annually with a dedicated residential IP.

limits.value: 60 phone credits a month on Free: 60 Android minutes or 20 iPhone minutes; top up 100 credits for USD 3
1 concurrent phone and 1 GB storage on Free
1 seat and 1 agent slot on Free; an account, an API key and a cloud device are required before a task can run

limits_note: Free has no overage charges: when the allowance runs out, prepaid packs are required or the user upgrades. Paid plans continue past the allowance at USD 0.03 per phone credit, USD 0.01 per AI credit and USD 10 per GB of residential traffic, up to a monthly overage limit.
binding_note: The 60 monthly phone credits run out after 60 Android minutes or 20 iPhone minutes, well before the 1 GB storage cap, and on Free there is no overage billing once they are spent.

identity_cost.detail: The service requires a DroidRun account: the terms state that registration and setting up a DroidRun Account is required. The console sign-in page is a JavaScript app whose configuration reports emailSignUpEnabled false, so the exact sign-up fields on the live page are unverified: behind a sign-up. The pricing FAQ states that eligible accounts can claim one free slot to connect their own phone with no credit card required; that is an add-on, not the Free cloud-phone plan.

reliability_note: Free has no overage charges and stops at its allowance until a top-up or upgrade. The terms state that DroidRun disclaims liability for storage, accessibility and integrity of stored data, and paid plans stop at a monthly overage limit until the user requests a higher one.
confidence_note: Prices, allowances and API access are quoted from first-party pricing, device and docs pages read on 2026-11-25. The account requirement is quoted from the first-party terms; the exact live sign-up form was not read because the console is a JavaScript app and email signup is reported disabled there.
